sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: An adapter protocol through which an AI host can call exposed tools.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: It is a plug connecting an assistant to tools, not the database’s rules.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: An agent calls a knowledge tool to retrieve authorized evidence.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: The stdio adapter projects service contracts with host-fixed workspace and principals.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Keeping MCP replaceable prevents one AI protocol from defining core knowledge semantics.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: The adapter can submit governed requests but cannot approve or execute Actions. It does not expose arbitrary Cypher.

sections.title: Implementation
sections.body: Open the checked implementation, tests, contracts and migrations below. These links identify evidence, not new verification.
